title: PokéSurvivor provisional starter tier list
basis: Provisional: combines two stat-based models (a guide site’s weighted score and a community-made stat-model tier chart dated Oct 13, 2026, game build a9b21f0) plus scattered player reports. Not a community consensus, and confidence is low. The gaps between starters are small (base stat total 307–320, atk 0.95–1.09); real power comes from gacha Pokémon. We review it weekly as the game updates.

starters.name: Litten
starters.why: Top five in both models; 107 spd and the joint-top bst (320).

starters.name: Scorbunny
starters.why: Top five in both models; the highest atk of any starter (1.09).

starters.name: Psyduck
starters.why: Top three in the guide-site model; starts with Confusion, a Psychic move.

starters.why: Top ten in both models; a guide site’s best all-rounder.
